theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the current headline theme with strong trend structure (durability_bar 0.82, hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 1.0, val_state 'confirming'), which makes it the most coherent surviving trend in a narrowing market. Because momentum rank is not alpha, this is a continuation lean sustained by the absolute-trend gate rather than a forecast of further outperformance.
evidence: Absolute-trend gate historically cuts drawdown on this market (gate_helps=true)
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.72 and crowded=true mean positioning is extended; the rule prohibits fading, but a crowded leader is the most fragile to a shake-out, and r10 already shows -0.0247 (slightly negative 10-day return) — the trend may be stalling rather than confirming.

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: Managed Care & Insurers has the highest durability_bar in the entire eligible universe (0.85) with a 'trend' hurst tag and high breadth (0.778). It is not the headline leader, which means less attention crowding, yet it screens as the most structurally durable trend available — a lower-attention continuation idea supported by the risk-control gate.
evidence: crowded=true but not the headline leader (less attention risk)
theses.dissent: It shares the XLV proxy with Health Care (Equal-Weight) and GLP-1, so a single policy or pharma headline could hit the whole XLV complex; the theme is eligible but mid-rank (21), and crowded=true flags sizing caution.

falsifier.text: XLV underperforms SPY by more than 3% while the absolute-trend gate flips ineligible for this theme

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: Non-AI Software scores high on durability (0.77) with a 'trend' hurst tag and broad participation (0.857), closely tracking Cybersecurity's structure but with slightly lower rank. It is the strongest adjacent trend to the leading software narrative, supported by the same trend-health legs rather than momentum rank.
evidence: Rank 3 adjacent to the Cybersecurity leader
theses.dissent: Crowded=true (crowding_z 1.45) and it is capped by the same top-of-software attention risk as Cybersecurity; if the software complex rolls over, Non-AI Software rolls with it, and there is no independent catalyst to cushion.

falsifier.text: IGV closes below its own 50-day moving average while CIBR continues higher, showing the theme lags rather than joins
